founders.name: Mattias Akke
founders.bio: Founder at Halmos Labs. Previously LLM researcher at MIT (Gómez-Bombarelli's lab) and AstraZeneca, developing frontier models for drug discovery. Published at NeurIPS on Bayesian optimization with LLMs. Research intern at Cambridge in Tuomas Knowles' group studying protein misfolding diseases. Chaired Kodsport Sverige, Sweden's largest competitive programming organization. Awarded Berzelianum grant by Swedish Royal Academy of Sciences (one chemist awarded per year).

founders.name: Linus von Ekensteen Löfgren
founders.bio: Founder at Halmos Labs. Previously Desk Quant at Danske Bank, building pricing algorithms and risk models across all asset classes. Conducted LLM security research at AI Sweden and quantum computing research at Chalmers. MS Engineering Physics and BA Economics from Lund University.

name: Acyclic Labs
description: Benchmarks, RL envs and infra for scaling agent swarms

founders.name: Ram Vinjamuri
founders.bio: Ram is a founder of Acyclic Labs. He started in ML research: his Cambridge dissertation on transfer learning for low-resource Vedic Sanskrit beat the state of the art and was published at ACL WiNLP. At Palantir, he was an FDE shipping multi-agent systems for clinical trial design. That work convinced him there are huge gains in scaling beyond the model. At Acyclic, he is building the infrastructure that lets agent swarms turn complex, long-running tasks from days into hours.

founders.name: Varun Latthe
founders.bio: Co-founder of Acyclic Labs (YC F26). At Cambridge, my research focused on building an auto-parallel programming language. I then worked on agent architecture and an Excel engine at Tracelight (https://tracelight.ai). At Acyclic, I’m building infrastructure that extracts implicit parallelism from agent workflows, turning them into efficient swarms for lower cost and latency.
